rows.standfirst: “This is more of a permanent approach,” says John Gehre, chief merchandising officer at Michaels. “… This is a more long-term strategy we want to put in place.”

rows.title: Coca-Cola only sold 1% more drinks last quarter, but it raised prices 13%. Its CEO said it has ‘the right strategies’ for sustained success
rows.standfirst: The beverage goliath is among several other snack and drink companies reaping the rewards of price hikes that far exceed inflation.
